instruct: Castilian Spanish accent from Spain (c and z pronounced as 'th'), natural and human, never robotic. Male narrator in his forties, very deep bass voice, cinematic trailer style but softer, slow and mysterious, a whisper of intrigue.

lineas.texto: Imagina que esta noche te duermes… y te despiertas en el año mil trescientos. Sin móvil. Sin luz. Y con un gallo gritándote en la oreja antes de que salga el sol.
